messages.meta.homeDescription: A community platform for sharing stories, travel, culture, and food around Taliabu Island.

messages.meta.submitOgDescription: Share stories, travel, culture, food, or local news from Taliabu Island.
messages.hero.subtitle: A community platform for sharing travel, culture, food, and local stories from across Taliabu Island.
messages.about.title: A story space for Taliabu Island
messages.about.subtitle: JelajahTaliabu collects local stories, travel, culture, food, and community news from residents.
messages.about.bodyOne: The platform gives Taliabu's local experiences and knowledge a place that is easy to find, read, and share.
messages.about.bodyTwo: Every community submission is reviewed by an admin before publication so the content stays relevant, clear, and useful.
messages.guide.title: Write clear and useful stories
messages.guide.subtitle: Use this guide before submitting an article so review can move faster.
messages.guide.pointOne: Choose a topic connected to Taliabu, such as travel, culture, food, local business, history, or community news.
messages.guide.pointTwo: Write clearly and include location, context, and details that help readers.
messages.guide.pointThree: Use a relevant cover image and make sure the file size follows the upload rules.
messages.guide.pointFour: Avoid hoaxes, hate speech, or claims that cannot be responsibly supported.
messages.footer.subtitle: Written by locals, for everyone.
messages.footer.tagline: A community platform for sharing stories, travel, culture, and food from Taliabu Island.
messages.footer.copy: © 2026 JelajahTaliabu. Written by locals, for everyone.
